description: Batch upload reusable Models from person photos the user attached in chat. Each photo becomes the upper_body_front identity anchor. Keep names and optional user-given age_range, build, and height_cm in avatars[], then pass top-level image_file_1, image_file_2, etc. in the same order. Traits are never guessed. No base64, no local paths. Do not use ordinary text-to-image results as an upload fallback. Use only when the user explicitly wants a specific or consistent person.
